properties.name: Shiggaon Taluk (approximate bounding box)
properties.note: This is a bounding-box approximation, NOT the true administrative polygon. For real GIS/watershed work, replace with the exact taluk polygon from Karnataka KGIS (kgis.ksrsac.in) or the Survey of India / SOI taluk boundary layer, or Bhuvan/LGD taluk shapefiles.
